sentences.text:
THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE  COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  WP No. 3051 of 2022  ORDER

This Court vide Peremptory order dated 7.3.2023 had stated as under:
"Learned Senior Panel Counsel Sri.Murugesh V Charati is requested to accept notice for the respondent.

Petitioner is directed to serve copy of the Petition along with all the documents on the Panel Counsel and file acknowledgement in the Registry of this Court within ten days,
failing which, the Petition stands rejected on that ground itself."
In terms of the above peremptory order, Writ Petition is dismissed.
